snippet.title: AnimaCircus - Announcement Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590590/AnimaCircus/

In AnimaCircus, the player gets into a circus troupe made out exclusively by cats, performing to a human audience excited to see your tricks.

Using the keyboard keys or controller buttons, press the direction shown on-screen at the right time to guarantee the best show possible. But don’t worry if you get it wrong, the spectators are very comprehensive.

#indiegame #animacircus #rhythmgame
